PHOENIX — OVERLAY PRESENTATION DECISIONS
Owner clarification: November 15, 2026

Navigation is a floating framed popup, not a full-screen takeover. The dimmed
source page stays visible around it. Two large illustrated destinations per row;
Constellation is centered on the final row. The wolf remains visible outside the
panel and toggles navigation open and closed. Outside tap and Escape also close.
Scroll overflow inside the popup; keep the source reader locked while open.
Restore exact source location and focus on close. Selected category retains a
steady category backlight and silver marker. Existing effect and reduced-motion
rules remain unchanged. Approved open-state mockup is the visual reference.

This v28 clarification supersedes v27 full-screen navigation. Other overlays are
unchanged by this slice; their presentation requires their own bounded review.

V29 warning access: six illustrated tiles in two columns by three rows. Warnings
uses the broken-seal dispatch, a live unresolved count and FINAL directly below
Warnings when the current step is a final opportunity. Its list replaces popup
contents with parchment entries; wolf remains the close toggle. Back restores
the artwork. Canonical risks are in cutoff order, resolved outcomes omitted;
unknowns show in-game verification guidance. Shared details and linked returns
restore the warning list and preserve the underlying reading position.
